title: Geek Bar - Strawberry Banana Ice - 30mL Salt Nic E-Liquid
description:
Geek Bar - Strawberry Banana Ice
delivers classic strawberry-banana cream with a cool, smooth finish. Part of the Geek Bar Nic Salts line  -  premium e-liquids designed for open pod systems, featuring the same iconic flavours from Geek Bar Pulse and Pulse X disposables. Each 30mL bottle delivers a 50/50 VG/PG ratio with 20mg/mL salt nicotine for smooth, satisfying performance.
Product Type:
Salt Nicotine E-Liquid
Flavour Profile:
Strawberry, Banana, Ice
Bottle Size:
30mL
VG/PG Ratio:
50/50
Nicotine Strength:
20mg
Brand:
Geek Bar
Salt nicotine e-liquids are designed for low-wattage pod systems. Not for sub-ohm devices.
This product contains nicotine. Nicotine is a highly addictive substance.
